en: The image is a black and white photograph depicting a bronze relief sculpture embedded in rock, showing a seated elderly woman in traditional attire, holding a book or tablet. The image is bordered in white, and there is printed text beneath the image. The name 'Prof. A. Adamson' is visible, along with the words 'Pronks reljeef' (Bronze relief) and 'Eesti rahva lauluema' (Mother of Song of the Estonian People).
